lessons.title: Talking About Likes

items.exampleMeaning: I think the food is good.

items.example: Was denkst du über das Buch?
items.exampleMeaning: What do you think about the book?

lessons.tip: In German, 'mögen' is used for likes and dislikes. For stronger feelings, use 'lieben' for love and 'hassen' for hate. Remember to use the correct verb form based on the subject.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Was denkst du über den Regen?
dialogue.meaning: What do you think about the rain?

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who shares opinions about the weather and seasons
scenario.learnerRole: someone expressing their likes and dislikes
scenario.brief: Talk about the weather and your feelings about it. Ask questions about your partner's opinions.
scenario.goal: You should express your likes and dislikes about the weather.

lessons.title: Sharing Experiences
lessons.tip: The past tense in German often uses the auxiliary verbs 'haben' or 'sein' with the past participle. Pay attention to which verb to use with each action.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich habe auch einen Film gesehen.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who has seen a movie and shared experiences
scenario.brief: Discuss what you and your partner have done recently. Ask about their experiences.
scenario.goal: You should share your past experiences and ask about theirs.

lessons.title: Expressing Opinions

items.example: Ich denke, dass das Wetter schön ist.
items.exampleMeaning: I think that the weather is nice.

items.example: Meiner Meinung nach ist der Film langweilig.
items.exampleMeaning: In my opinion, the movie is boring.

items.example: Ich finde, dass das Essen lecker ist.
items.exampleMeaning: I find that the food is delicious.

items.example: Ich glaube, dass es morgen regnet.
items.exampleMeaning: I believe that it will rain tomorrow.

items.example: Was meinst du über den Film?
items.exampleMeaning: What do you mean about the movie?

lessons.tip: Use phrases like 'Ich denke, dass...' to express your opinion. 'Meiner Meinung nach...' is another way to start your opinion.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ich finde, dass das Essen lecker ist.
dialogue.meaning: I find that the food is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Meiner Meinung nach ist der Film langweilig.
dialogue.meaning: In my opinion, the movie is boring.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ich denke, dass das Wetter schön ist.
dialogue.meaning: I think that the weather is nice.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Was meinst du über das Wetter?
dialogue.meaning: What do you mean about the weather?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich glaube, dass es morgen regnet.
dialogue.meaning: I believe that it will rain tomorrow.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who shares opinions on various topics
scenario.brief: Discuss your opinions about food, movies, and weather.
scenario.goal: You should express your opinions and ask for theirs.

lessons.title: Likes, Dislikes, and Experiences

items.example: Ich fand es toll, dass du gekommen bist.
items.exampleMeaning: I found it great that you came.

items.example: Ich habe den Film nicht gemocht.
Es war nicht gut, das zu hören.
items.exampleMeaning: It was not good to hear that.

items.example: Was hast du über das Konzert gedacht?
items.exampleMeaning: What did you think about the concert?

lessons.tip: When talking about past experiences, use the past tense forms of verbs. Remember to express your feelings clearly using 'mochte' and 'fand'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich fand es toll, dass du gekommen bist.
dialogue.meaning: I found it great that you came.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich habe den Film nicht gemocht.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Es war nicht gut, das zu hören.
dialogue.meaning: It was not good to hear that.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Was hast du über das Konzert gedacht?
dialogue.meaning: What did you think about the concert?

scenario.partnerRole: a friend who shares experiences and opinions
scenario.learnerRole: someone reflecting on experiences and feelings
scenario.brief: Share your experiences and feelings about books, movies, and concerts.
scenario.goal: You should express your likes and dislikes and ask for their thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich finde, dass sie toll ist.
dialogue.meaning: I think that it is great.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ich habe ein gutes Buch gelesen.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich mochte den Film, den ich gesehen habe.
dialogue.meaning: I liked the movie that I saw.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend discussing various experiences and opinions
scenario.learnerRole: someone sharing their thoughts and experiences
scenario.brief: Discuss your opinions about music, books, and movies. Share your experiences and ask questions.
scenario.goal: You should express your feelings and ask for their opinions.
